sensitivePaths.label: Cut the power of a server
Cut the power of a server

agentGuide: Base path /v1. Servers: GET /v1/servers (id, name, status, public_net.ipv4.ip, server_type.name, datacenter); one: GET /v1/servers/<id>; metrics: GET /v1/servers/<id>/metrics?type=cpu&start=<ISO>&end=<ISO>. Actions: POST /v1/servers/<id>/actions/poweron (poweroff, reboot, shutdown, reset); an action: GET /v1/actions/<id>. Create: POST /v1/servers {"name": "...", "server_type": "cx22", "image": "debian-12", "location": "fsn1", "ssh_keys": [..]} — it costs money. Catalogue: GET /v1/server_types, /v1/images?type=system, /v1/locations, /v1/ssh_keys. Firewalls: GET /v1/firewalls; volumes: GET /v1/volumes; snapshots: GET /v1/images?type=snapshot. Pricing: GET /v1/pricing. The token is set by Allkin.
